units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Genesis 3:18">Targ. Y. Gen. III, 18</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 16:26">Targ. Prov. XVI, 26</cite> <he>לָעֲיָא</he>.—
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 32:4">Lev. R. s. 32</cite> <he>לְעֵי טבאות</he> work right (Tanḥ. Emor 24 <cite ref="L00504"><he>ליענות</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:15">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> <he>לית את אזיל לָעֵי ונגיס</he> why doest thou not go working and have something to eat?—Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ top <he>דא̇ינון לָעֲיֵי</he> because they are working beasts.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 6:1:10">Y. Sabb. VI, 7ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>והוא לעי באורייתא</he> that he might be able to study the Law; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:1:18">Y. Erub. I, 18ᵈ</cite> top <he>ולָעֲתָהּ בתריה וכ׳</he> (cmp. <he>חמת־</he> for <cite ref="H01172"><he>חמי</he></cite>) and he studied (repeated) it after him forty times; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:1:18">ib.</cite> <he>ולעיתה</he> (read <he>ולָעֲתֵיה</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 18:18">Targ. Y. Ex. XVIII, 18</cite> <he>מִילְעָא תִילְעֵי</he> Ar. (ed. <he>מיתר תנתר</he>; O. <he>מִילְאָה תִלְאֵי</he>).

I, 40ᵇ</cite> <he>והוא לעי</he> and he became tired (ceased from raving).
